title: Sign encoding via the Boolean real embedding
statement: Let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ be a Boolean function, and define its real embedding to be $1$ where $f(x)=1$ and $0$ otherwise. Its real sign encoding is the function $x\mapsto 1-2$ times this real embedding.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $\mathbb F_2^n$
